note: Grade/UMS data for GCSE Further Mathematics (cash-in G2337) lives in the shared boundaries file under the key 'furtherMaths': subjectMaxUms 200, subjectBoundaries, aStarBySeries, units U1-U4 (rawMax, umsMax, thresholds a-g), combinations, rawBoundaries and sources. Unit keys there are U1..U4 (boundary codes GFM1..GFM4); the pack uses FM1..FM4. scripts/validate-packs.mjs checks that the key exists.
